answer: Make every identity earn through one bridge at a time: a single, key-bound work ticket per epoch that cannot be copied, because each ticket carries a pigment, a unique fingerprint of the agent public key and its honest work, checked against the ledger before any payout. A farm that clones an identity only creates an echo of the same ticket, and the ledger pays the first submission once, so a thousand clones earn no more than the one original while each clone still pays its own compute cost.
